title: Creating Disability Story Videos with Generative AI: Motivation, Expression, and Sharing

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of user prompts and semi-structured interviews with nine participants with disabilities as they used generative AI tools (ChatGPT, DALL-E, ElevenLabs) to co-create video stories. The study evaluated how AI models misrepresented disabled bodies, relied on stereotypes, and failed to accurately generate specific assistive technologies.
